Menstruating Aisha combed and washed the Prophet's head during his I'tikaf and fetched him the mat; he drank and ate where she had, and recited Quran in her lap.
Asked how to bathe after menstruation, the Prophet taught the bath and a musk-scented piece of cotton for purifying; Aisha quietly explained it is applied to the traces of blood.
Fatimah b. Abu Hubaish and Umm Habiba, whose bleeding continued, were told it is a vein, not menstruation: leave prayer for the usual days, then bathe and pray.
Asking whether the questioner is a Haruriya, Aisha says menstruating women were told to make up missed fasts but not missed prayers.
